scores.thoughts: This bill prohibits the provision of federal funds for election administration to states that do not allow local governments to hold elections in odd-numbered years. This would reduce federal spending on elections in non-compliant states, thus decreasing overall government spending related to election administration.

The bill aims to influence how local elections are scheduled by withholding federal funds, promoting the idea that odd-numbered year elections for local offices lead to more informed voters and greater attention to local issues. This is a significant reform to election administration practices, though it doesn't directly address voter access or security measures like voter ID.
